correctness.rationale: For all q>=3 and n>=3, the overlap digraph is balanced/strongly connected. All Hamming-weight-two vertices have forced zero exits; contracting these gives the stated qr color-position Laplacian. The decomposition of J_{q-1} into constant/sum-zero colors gives a q^{m(q-2)} factor. A determinant-one column transform and outer-to-inner triangular ordering prove the remaining determinant q^{floor(m/2)} for all m. Directed BEST then multiplies by ((q-1)!)^{1+m(q-1)}. Independent exact determinant and fully enumerated Euler-tour checks passed in check_sparse_cycles.py; finite tests do not replace the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: The result gives the exact size of the entire design space for the first multicolor sparse two-defect window language, rather than existence or a single construction. The nontrivial q^{m(q-2)+floor(m/2)} factor isolates color-difference and reflection sectors of in-arborescence choices, enabling an exact benchmark for uniform random generation and finite-alphabet sequence design. This is a motivated structural enumeration answering the number-of-cycles question raised by recent literature, not a routine small-n table.
